name: SeaSons: Frost Bites ❄
source:
In the visual novel "SeaSons: Frost Bites" you embark on an enchanting journey set on a lonely, arctic island. Lost pirate girl Vira discovers unexpected love when she meets the caring shark merman Arodon. With a mix of humor, flirty exchanges and a lot of vibrant hair, you shape their relationship and experience the magic of their arctic adventure.

Will you be able to leave this island or will you be frozen in place?

Only one way to find out.

[from [url=https://l34ndr4.itch.io/seasons-frost-bites]itch.io[/url]]
